Courier and parcel collection brand artwork

All trademarks and artwork remain the property of the respective brand owners.
The project MIT license applies to application code; it does not grant rights to
these third-party marks. Their use identifies the carrier or parcel collection
service named in a user record. No affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement is
asserted. Logos are displayed in their original colors and aspect ratios.

Official source pages, asset URLs, retrieval date, original and resource SHA-256
digests, and technical format conversions are recorded in carrier-logos.json.
